acceptance_scope: Narrow Stage0 prototype per specification section 41; does not accept linked production/MVP features
assertion: Во время непрерывной Vault rotation/revoke и изменения ресурсов создавать backup; kill/powerfail каждой фазы PREPARE/PIN/SNAPSHOT/SEAL/SIGN/PUBLISH. Все COMPLETED архивы восстанавливают все reference/key_versions/audit head; INCOMPLETE не предлагаются к восстановлению.
environment: Disposable GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04.5; Python 3.13 unit/native labs, Python 3.12 QEMU harness; Docker 29.9.3, Compose 2.38.2, age 1.3.2; no user VPS/SSH keys
fault_injection: SIGKILL at each coordinator phase boundary under the continuous workload; separate ENOSPC/deadline/corrupt-object injections
initial_state: Live SQLite/Vault with retained old generation and continuous rotation, exact-version revoke and resource revisions
limits: Automated self-review, not an independent human security audit.
QEMU guests, managed services and SFTP share one hypervisor; external operator/offline Owner roles are automated fixture processes.
Independent VPS/targets in dependency tests are inventory scopes on the fixture runner, not independently administered production machines.
SIGKILL/ENOSPC phase-boundary injection does not prove physical power-loss or arbitrary filesystem/storage durability.
Backend approval authority and managed root/Docker daemon remain within the stated TCB; knowingly false Owner attestation is not detected with a guarantee.
Lab dependency SBOM is scoped and incomplete for a production release; package install/update/restore integration remains unaccepted.
observation: Continuous rotation, exact-version revocation and resource revisions run concurrently with three completed backups. Independent bundle restore compares every captured reference, generation, resource, revocation, audit row and empty work set. AEAD decrypt and ciphertext hashes prove all needed keys and objects remain portable, including retained old generation. SIGKILL at every phase boundary during the same mutation workload leaves only PUBLISHED archives eligible; interrupted pins are released.
